GlobalVariables.StudyDescription: Compiled GFlow study design for NCT03922750 Benchmark.

ItemDef.Name: Treatment after the end of the trial

Decode.TranslatedText: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

CodeListDef.Name: Action Taken with Study Treatment Codelist

Decode.TranslatedText: 0 - Fully active, able to carry on all pre-disease performance without restriction
1 - Restricted in physically strenuous activity but ambulatory and able to carry out light work
2 - Ambulatory and capable of all selfcare but unable to carry out any work activities
3 - Capable of only limited selfcare; confined to bed or chair >50% of waking hours
4 - Completely disabled; cannot carry on any selfcare

ConditionDef.Name: Systolic BP Greater Than Diastolic BP
ConditionDef.Description: Systolic blood pressure must exceed diastolic blood pressure.

ConditionDef.Name: Pregnancy Assessment Restricted to Females
ConditionDef.Description: Pregnancy testing is only applicable to female subjects.

ConditionDef.Name: Dose Date Concurrence with Visit Date
ConditionDef.Description: Dose administration date must match visit date on dosing visits.

ConditionDef.Name: Absolute Neutrophil Count Safety Clearance
ConditionDef.Description: Absolute Neutrophil Count must be >= 1.0 x 10^9/L to initiate cycle.

ConditionDef.Name: Adverse Event Date Chronology
ConditionDef.Description: Adverse event resolution date must be on or after onset date.

ConditionDef.Name: Grade 3+ Toxicity Dose Delay Requirement
ConditionDef.Description: Severe toxicity (CTCAE Grade >= 3) mandates dose delay or modification.

ConditionDef.Name: Fatal Adverse Event Study Disposition Sync
ConditionDef.Description: Fatal outcome requires matching Death disposition record.

ConditionDef.Name: Pregnancy Test Even-Numbered Cycle Cadence (Footnote 3)
ConditionDef.Description: Mandates pregnancy test within 1 week prior to start of treatment, on Day 1 of every even-numbered cycle (2, 4, 6, etc.), and at end of study (Footnote 3).

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Pregnancy test, if applicable, will be performed within 1 week prior to start of treatment, and on Day 1 of every even numbered treatment cycle (2, 4, 6, etc ) and at the end of the study
